solution_summary: Thinking differently about using data At the heart of its business and digital transformation is the drive to improve customer service and launch more convenient banking products. Digital transformation on developers' terms As a technological leader in the Australian financial services market, Bendigo and Adelaide Bank was eager to enable its developers to focus on more innovation so the bank could remain agile in a fast-moving market. That meant empowering teams with a streamlined and powerful tech stack on which to modernize and build improved apps and services. Bendigo and Adelaide Bank had a lot of duplicate systems and processes that had evolved over time and through many years of mergers and acquisitions. As the team worked to accelerate the transformation of the bank, for simplification and cloud centricity, MongoDB was the perfect choice as the leading modern, multi-cloud database platform.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Provides the managed document database backing Bendigo and Adelaide Bank's modernized application platform.

data_flow: Operational data from legacy or distributed applications is consolidated in MongoDB Atlas, where flexible document models support microservices, APIs, and downstream user experiences without batch-heavy synchronization. Upstream and downstream integrations include AWS, Google Cloud, Azure.
business_outcome: Minimizing Risk and Reducing Complexity While the pace of transformation continues across Bendigo and Adelaide Bank, the team remains focused on transforming the business for the future as it strives to deliver on its vision to be Australia’s bank of choice.
metrics: For example, AI-powered automation reduced the time spent running application test cases from over 80 hours to just five minutes.
architecture_clues: The solution uses a microservices-based architecture.
The deployment is designed for multi-cloud flexibility.
The deployment integrates with Google Cloud.
evidence_quotes: “It has always been about making things simpler and easier for our customers,”
“We wanted to prove that we could move faster, develop things in smaller chunks using a schema-agnostic database, and make changes more quickly, with no outages.”
“The fact that MongoDB Atlas supported the three major hyperscalers [Google Cloud, AWS, Azure] helped with portability and supports a multi-cloud future for us.”
